This webinar will examine how AI is influencing the skills required of health professionals, transforming workforce deployment and decision-making and shaping national and global health labour markets. epidemiology.summary: Join this FREE online webinar held by the Royal College of General Practitioners (RCGP) in collaboration with the World Health Organisation (WHO).Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping health systems, creating new opportunities and challenges for workforce education, management and planning. This webinar will examine how AI is influencing the skills required of health professionals, transforming workforce deployment and decision-making and shaping national and global health labour markets. Participants will explore key lessons from emerging practice, including both the benefits of AI-enabled innovation and the barriers that may limit its adoption, such as workforce readiness, regulation, ethics and equity concerns.
